profit_harvest.note: Thresholds trigger a harvest review. They are not take-profit or stop orders. An intact thesis does not by itself justify holding full size.
profit_harvest.question: If flat today, would you initiate this exact trade at this exact size and level?

psychology.boundary: Private decision machinery. Never quote or paraphrase in public prose. This state never sizes, forces, or blocks a trade.

current_sofr.citation: official NY Fed SOFR 3.88 percent dated 2026-10-20 ACT/360

recent_funding_views.implication: Remain at the zero official-SOFR benchmark. Flat cash is not alpha, but with no residual edge the alternative is worse: paying SOFR on shocked-risk capital to own a hike path already printed in Dec26 4.255 / Mar27 4.55 / Jun27 4.725 / Sep27 4.785. Do not fund a new risk book off 3.88 SOFR until realized funding is shown, with a dated catalyst, to print away from that strip.
recent_funding_views.sr3_forward_view: Over the decision horizon the SR3 strip already embeds a steep tightening path versus the 3.88 official fixing: Dec26 4.255, Mar27 4.55, Jun27 4.725, Sep27 4.785. That is a front-loaded hike sequence of roughly 37.5bp into year-end 2026 and about 90bp by Sep27, so apparent funding-tightening or hawkish-repricing edges are the curve, not a mispricing of it. No unpriced residual versus those four contracts is identified in the frozen funding_context.
